headline: India’s Composite PMI Barely Moves as Factory Reading Rises and Services Ease
deck: The flash survey was compiled by S&P Global from responses collected between 11 and 18 November.
body: India’s HSBC Flash India Composite Purchasing Managers’ Index edged up to 56.3 in November from 56.2 in October. [E1] The manufacturing PMI rose to a nine-month high of 56.0 from 54.7, with faster manufacturing output growth offsetting softer services activity. [E2]

The services PMI slipped to 55.3 from 55.8, while growth in new business was unchanged from October. [E3] S&P Global compiled the data, released on 23 November, from responses collected between 11 and 18 November. [E4]
